source_scope: one de-identified owner-controlled pressure logger bundle

runtime_behavior.station_boundary_fit: reject non-positive mapped pressure values and retain a quality warning
runtime_behavior.boundary_profile_reader: skip rows without a positive mapped pressure
runtime_behavior.synchronized_replay: exclude non-positive pressure values and propagate the warning to alignment metadata

claim_boundary: This artifact records a private-data quality correction and a bounded pressure-envelope recheck. It does not establish full station-to-vehicle validation, universal operating limits, safety distances, failure frequencies, or equipment identity.
